source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about ME recover
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for ME recover (via the ME-recover (standalone)) requires physically moving the ME-recover jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS ME-recover (standalone) page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the ME-recover jumper (ME-recover (standalone)), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. It correctly identifies physical/pre-OS work but does not protect against accidentally initiating ME firmware recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED and explicitly limits the test to switch/page verification, not ME flashing.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 Pilot record exists for this source key.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No V3.1 200-case record exists for this source key.

original_test_intent: Verify that the physical ME-recovery switch/jumper selects the intended recovery/function indication, allows the specified boot behavior and returns to normal operation after restoration, without authorizing a firmware recovery write.
original_method: Under the board's power-off procedure, an engineer moves the ME-recovery control to the documented alternate position, boots to and records the specified BIOS jumper/function page, avoids starting recovery, restores the original position and checks clean boot and unchanged ME firmware identity.
manual_activity: The engineer must physically reposition and restore the ME-recovery jumper and visually interpret the pre-OS result. These are the acceptance actions; agent firmware inventory is only supporting evidence.
required_inputs: Exact board revision, jumper designator, orientations and energized/de-energized move rules
Authoritative BIOS page/result and whether recovery starts automatically
Baseline ME/BIOS versions and prohibition or authorization scope for any side effect
Known-good contingency recovery image/tool and OOB/KVM path
Maintenance approval and qualified physical operator
safety_requirements: Power down/discharge and follow ESD procedure before moving the control; never guess orientation.
Do not start an ME recovery, write or flash unless separately and explicitly approved.
Verify the jumper is restorable and recovery media is compatible before booting the alternate state.
Stop on recovery prompt, firmware identity change, POST/hang or management loss; preserve evidence and do not retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect immutable ME/BIOS/BMC identities and health before and after the manual sequence.
Prepare evidence checkpoints and organize operator position photos and BIOS/KVM captures.
Detect firmware identity or management-health changes and report them separately from the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the non-flash boundary and contingency recovery path.
Move, boot/observe and restore the physical ME-recovery control.
Confirm normal boot/management state and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual sequence preserves the control path, but it omits the critical distinction between showing a recovery-mode page and executing recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only firmware identity and health queries only. No ME update or recovery command belongs in this testcase without a separate approved scope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate/original switch states, function-page observation, clean-boot criteria and 5/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL JUMPER; PROHIBIT UNPLANNED RECOVERY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a board-specific position/power matrix, capture alternate-state BIOS indication, verify no write begins, restore the control and compare cryptographically or version-wise stable ME/BIOS identity plus normal management health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board, ME generation, BIOS/BMC and recovery circuit.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, ME, BIOS and BMC firmware revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner service manual and ME-recovery behavior/recovery documents.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit no-flash and identity checks while retaining the physical function test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; firmware recovery execution is deliberately excluded because the source only asks for switch function.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Jumper map, page semantics, auto-action behavior and contingency recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms may begin recovery automatically, so page observation cannot be assumed safe.

project_override_considerations: If a project intends to validate an actual ME recovery, that is a materially broader firmware-write case requiring a separate image/tool/compatibility/recovery plan. Missing board data makes this switch test NOT READY, not permanently BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Board/jumper procedure, baseline ME/BIOS identity, expected page/behavior, contingency recovery and approval
Timestamped alternate-position and BIOS/KVM function-page evidence with no recovery write
Unchanged firmware identity, normal POST/OS/BMC/SEL health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for alternate-state function verification and restored clean boot. It does not instruct a firmware recovery operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual switch test is intelligible; platform-specific automatic behavior and recovery are readiness gates rather than permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep the physical/pre-OS boundary and add the no-flash/auto-recovery risk.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its distinct ME recovery safety boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Maintains readiness versus classification separation without broadening the test into firmware flashing.

review_improvement: Prevents a benign jumper-page check from silently becoming a high-risk ME recovery and requires unchanged firmware identity after restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The switch and BIOS observation are inherently physical/manual. Because the source validates control recognition and clean restoration, not a recovery image, no automated firmware action is appropriate. Missing platform details affect readiness only.
